daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has designated Bupati Langkat Syah Afandin and his campaign team member as suspects in a project bribery case. The Bupati received Rp 800 million in bribes, and the KPK seized Rp 1.32 billion in cash and foreign currency during the sting operation. The commission highlighted "regeneration of corruption" in Langkat as the bupati allegedly demanded fees of 10 percent from education projects and 17 percent from housing projects.

  • The KPK revealed that the Bupati's campaign team member received Rp 10.2 billion in projects following the regional election, with bribe money delivered through his driver and associates.
  • Besides bribery, Bupati Langkat is also suspected of receiving Rp 3.5 billion in gratuities.
  • The KPK will conduct an evaluation regarding two recent regional head stings that were leaked, as the Bupati knew he was being monitored by KPK.
  • Gus Ipul has firmly stated he does not wish to become the new chairman of PBNU and hopes not to be nominated.
  • Hashim Djojohadikusumo, President Prabowo's brother, indicated there are signs of irregularities in the President's priority programs.
  • The Supreme Court rejected the appeal of former South Jakarta District Court Chief Arif Nuryanta, keeping his 14-year prison sentence in place.
  • Wali Kota Solo Respati was reported to the prosecutor's office over the installation of billboards celebrating Jokowi's birthday.

Foreign Policy & Defence

A coordinating minister condemned the killing of a US pilot by an armed group in Papua and vowed to pursue the perpetrators. The TNI evacuated the American pilot whose aircraft was burned by the armed separatist group. A DPR deputy chair called on the government to enhance security in Papua following the incident.

  • Indonesia and Germany have partnered to expedite low-carbon transition initiatives.
  • The trade minister announced that the Indonesia-European Union CEPA has entered a key approval phase.
  • Indonesia's deputy foreign minister boosted economic ties with the Islamic world during a visit to Kyrgyzstan.
  • Jayapura Hospital is ready to become a referral hub for Papua New Guinea patients.
  • An Indonesian volunteer organization distributed food to orphans in Gaza.

Other

Indonesia has lifted its 11-year ban on Reddit after the platform achieved regulatory compliance. The Ministry of Industry intervened following a herbal factory explosion that caused fatalities. The government announced plans to establish a new International Financial Center of Indonesia (PFII).

  • Mount Anak Krakatau's alert level was raised to Level III following increased volcanic activity.
  • Indonesia has reached 48.5 percent of its subsidized fertilizer distribution target.
  • The government is developing "nutripreneurs" to support the free meals program.
  • Authorities uncovered a Rp 29 billion financial manipulation scheme.
  • A Constitutional Court judge questioned the urgency of the free meals program amid limitations in education services.
